The '''tris''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of six-legged animal that was native to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coyn]] in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] and employed by the [[Coynite/Legends|Coynites]] as mounts. They could grow up to 3.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and 2 meters tall at the shoulder. From childhood, a Coynite was paired with a tris that became his companion and with which they were said to have a spiritual bond. The Coynite who rode the tris is called its ''kars'asruul'' which translated as "soulrider". The kars'asruul braids the tris's mane to match his own and often paints runes of their accomplishments on the animal side. The tris were headstrong and very difficult to ride by others that are not their kars'asruul. They were predatory animals with fangs and red pupil-less [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] which made them an intimidating sight.<ref name="planets3" /> [[Thaddeus Ross]] once delivered a baby tris to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="final exit">{{JournalCite|4|The Final Exit|reprint=1}}</ref>
